scripts.lint:workspace: bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error lint:ruff lint:deptry lint:source-rules lint:ty lint:basedpyright lint:type-boundaries lint:type-boundaries:tests lint:architecture lint:annotations lint:vulture lint:fields lint:public lint:config format:check
scripts.lint:fix: uv run --all-packages ruff check --fix src tests scripts notebooks && bun run format
scripts.lint:ruff: uv run --all-packages ruff check --no-fix src tests scripts notebooks && uv run --all-packages python -m grassmoth_checks.run_pydoclint --config pyproject.toml --quiet src
scripts.lint:source-rules: uv run --all-packages ruff check src --no-fix --select FBT001,FBT002,PGH003
scripts.lint:type-boundaries: uv run --all-packages python -m grassmoth_checks.check_type_boundaries src scripts notebooks
scripts.lint:type-boundaries:tests: uv run --all-packages python -m grassmoth_checks.check_type_boundaries --select CORE001 --select CORE002 tests
scripts.lint:fields: uv run --all-packages python -m grassmoth_checks.check_fields --select FIELD001 --select FIELD002
scripts.lint:public: uv run --all-packages python -m grassmoth_checks.check_public_imports src scripts notebooks
scripts.format: uv run --all-packages ruff format src tests scripts notebooks
scripts.format:check: uv run --all-packages ruff format --check src tests scripts notebooks
